name: 10032 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10032 (New York) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10032 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10032 (New York) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
